Protein is up, and CPTAC RNA and TCGA RNA are up, so replicated. CD8_T share (0.533) exceeds RCC (0.345), so not tumour-intrinsic. Surface call is surface. IHC was not measured and the proteome is not enriched. DepMap fails.
